devices.text: Over the last 30 days the fridge used the most: 38.2 kWh, 24% of the home, about 106,000 ₫ [1]. Second is the always-on background load, 31.5 kWh: you can cut it without changing habits. The dishwasher and washing machine together took 43.4 kWh, mostly to heat water. Money is split on the same tiers the whole home pays [2].
followUps: What makes up the background load?

bill.text: This cycle your home used 267.9 kWh, 25% more than the last, mostly in weeks 3 and 4. Two main reasons: it ran 2.8 °C hotter than usual, so the fridge ran longer [2], and the washing machine ran 5 extra times. Because the price is tiered, the extra 54 kWh fell on the higher tiers, so the cost rose 31%, about 172,000 ₫ [1].
followUps: How much will I pay at the cycle's end?
Which device uses the most power?

forecast.text: So far your home has used 168 kWh. At the pace of the last 7 days the cycle ends near 236 kWh, or 712,000 ₫. 32 kWh more reaches the next price tier, likely before the 24th; each kWh after that costs about 26% more [1].
followUps: Why is this cycle's bill higher than the last?

weather.text: Today is 34 °C, feels like 39 °C, humidity 68% [1]. Before 10 am it is still cool: open the windows instead of turning on the air conditioner. If you use it, set 27–28 °C with a fan; each degree lower costs about 5–7% more. Drink enough water and stay in between 11 am and 3 pm.

plan.text: I picked four small changes from your home's last 30 days; none costs you comfort. Together they should save 22.3 kWh, about 64,700 ₫ a month [2]. Vietnamese households shown feedback on their power cut use by 4–7% [1]. Start a 7-day trial and Wappi will measure the real result.
followUps: What makes up the background load?

standby.label: Switch the TV and speakers off at the wall
standby.detail: About 12 W less background load · 8.6 kWh/month

dishwasher.label: Run the dishwasher on eco, skip heated drying

kettle.label: Boil only the water you need

peers.text: Over the last 30 days your home used 312 kWh, 16% more than the median of 1,240 homes with the same floor area and household size. 62% of similar homes use less. The biggest gap is the background load and the dishwasher. The more accurate your home details, the closer the comparison [1].
followUps: What is background load, and is mine high?

standby.text: Background load is the power drawn when nobody is using anything: the router, chargers, a TV on standby, the fridge at rest. Yours is about 112 W, up 14% in 2 weeks, which is 75.6 kWh and 219,000 ₫ a month [1]. The rise began on day 8; usually a new device plugged in or left on standby. Each 10 W less saves about 88 kWh a year.

clarify.text: I'm not sure which side you want to look at. Pick one so I compute the right thing.
clarify.question: What should Wappi look at?
